explication: This repository is both a PostgreSQL learning tutorial and a small GitHub-data collection example. The documented learning path introduces PostgreSQL, getting started, SQL queries, writing queries, and deployment; the sampled runtime separately serves a client page and includes a scraper that stores GitHub data. Runtime links are limited to relationships visible in the excerpts or source index. The schema, query examples, and guide files are present in the tree, but their contents were not sampled.
